minutes.headline: Commission limited a Lake Shirley owner to two of four docks and backed a Gilchrist Street land swap article
minutes.summary: The Conservation Commission heard a run of wetlands filings: a trail bridge, docks, a sandy beach, an enforcement matter, Woodlands accessibility work and a beach erosion update. It agreed to sponsor a land swap warrant article for access to the Lane property and reviewed its trust funds. Some matters were continued or approved with conditions.

what_happened.line: The Commission allowed two of four docks to remain at 40 Fire Road 12, on condition, and the owner is to say which two before the order is signed.
It voted to sponsor a warrant article for a Gilchrist Street land swap, with amended access language.
The hearing on a sandy beach at 307 Townsend Harbor Road was continued to April 4.
It issued negative determinations for the Northfield Road bridge and the Woodlands work, and an order of conditions for an access ramp at 208 Northfield Road.
Members reviewed conservation trust fund balances and authorized pollinator plants from the revolving fund.

why_it_matters: The dock limit shows how the Commission applies its wetlands conditions to lakefront property, and the land swap article affects town-held land and access to the Lane property.
If the land swap article reaches the warrant, residents will be asked to vote on it at Town Meeting.
watch_next: April 4: continued hearing on the sandy beach at 307 Townsend Harbor Road.
Next meeting: the order of conditions for the 40 Fire Road 12 docks, once the owner names the two he keeps.
